ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a JK flip-flop, with A, CP, and B inputs on the left, and the output on the right labeled Q. A passes through the upper AND gate and is sent to the J terminal, and B passes through the lower AND gate and is sent to the K terminal; the feedback line returns from the flip-flop output to the two gated inputs. According to the problem's method, assign the gated relationship in the figure as J = A·overline(Q^n), K = B·Q^n. Reasoning: The characteristic equation of the JK flip-flop is Q^(n+1) = J·overline(Q^n) + overline(K)·Q^n. Substituting J and K gives Q^(n+1) = (A·overline(Q^n))·overline(Q^n) + overline(B·Q^n)·Q^n. Using overline(Q^n)·overline(Q^n)=overline(Q^n), and overline(B·Q^n)·Q^n = (overline(B)+overline(Q^n))·Q^n = overline(B)·Q^n, obtain Q^(n+1)=A·overline(Q^n)+overline(B)·Q^n.

method.method_draft: From the image, assign the gated flip-flop inputs as \(J=A\overline{Q^n}\) and \(K=BQ^n\). Substitute these into the JK characteristic equation: \(Q^{n+1}=J\overline{Q^n}+\overline{K}Q^n=(A\overline{Q^n})\overline{Q^n}+\overline{BQ^n}Q^n\). Simplify to obtain \(A\overline{Q^n}+\overline{B}Q^n\).

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the diagram as a clocked JK flip-flop block with inputs labeled 1J and 1K and clock CP/C1. The upper AND gate feeds J and has inputs A and the complemented feedback output \(\overline{Q^n}\). The lower AND gate feeds K and has inputs B and the non-complemented feedback output \(Q^n\).
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to identify the requested quantity as the next-state expression \(Q^{n+1}\), not the output waveform or timing behavior.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the JK flip-flop next-state relation \(Q^{n+1}=J\overline{Q^n}+\overline{K}Q^n\), then apply Boolean algebra: idempotence \(\overline{Q}\,\overline{Q}=\overline{Q}\), De Morgan \(\overline{BQ}=\overline{B}+\overline{Q}\), and \(\overline{Q}Q=0\).
